items.title: 10.4 Oxidising agent (oxidant) aur reducing agent (reductant) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.4, printed page 217.

blocks.title: Oxidising aur reducing agents
blocks.text: Oxidising agent (atom, ion ya molecule) woh madda hai jo kisi doosre madde ko oxidise karta hai aur khud ek ya zyada electrons hasil kar ke kam oxidation state mein reduce hota hai. Reducing agent woh madda hai jo kisi doosre madde ko reduce karta hai aur khud ek ya zyada electrons kho kar zyada oxidation state mein oxidise hota hai.

Agar koi element ek ya zyada electrons hasil kar ke anion ban jaye, X + e- se X-, to woh oxidising agent ka kaam karta hai, kyunke woh doosre atom se electron kheenchta hai aur us ka apna oxidation number girta hai (0 se -1): misal ke taur par Cl + e- se Cl-. Agar koi element electron kho kar cation ban jaye, M se M+ + e-, to woh reducing agent ka kaam karta hai, kyunke woh electrons deta hai aur us ka oxidation number barhta hai (0 se +1): misal ke taur par Na se Na+ + e-.

blocks.prompt: Fe2O3 + 3CO se 2Fe + 3CO2 mein oxidise aur reduce hone wali species aur oxidising aur reducing agents pehchanein (Quick Check 10.2a).
blocks.explanation: Iron Fe2O3 mein +3 se Fe mein 0 jata hai: reduced, to Fe2O3 oxidising agent hai. Carbon CO mein +2 se CO2 mein +4 jata hai: oxidised, to CO reducing agent hai.

items: Oxidising agent: doosron ko oxidise karta, khud reduce hota hai (e- leta hai, Cl se Cl-). Reducing agent: doosron ko reduce karta, khud oxidise hota hai (e- khota hai, Na se Na+).
